column.name: description
column.value: Multi-tranche loans and the sub-status of the tranche waiting to be disbursed.

insert.column: SELECT o.name AS office, ms.display_name AS loanOfficer, mc.display_name AS clientName, ml.account_no AS loanAccount, lp.name AS product, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d WHERE d.loan_id = ml.id AND d.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL) AS trancheNumber, CASE ml.loan_sub_status_id WHEN 400 THEN 'Repayment conditions not met' WHEN 410 THEN 'Repayment conditions met' WHEN 420 THEN 'Awaiting survey' WHEN 430 THEN 'Survey successful' WHEN 440 THEN 'Expired' WHEN 450 THEN 'Requires review' ELSE '' END AS trancheStatus, sched.duedate AS firstRepaymentDueDate, mile.operational_status AS operationalStatus, mile.additional_funding AS additionalFunding, mile.conducted_by AS conductedBy, mile.conducted_on AS conductedOn FROM m_loan ml JOIN m_product_loan lp ON lp.id = ml.product_id LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id LEFT JOIN m_office o ON o.id = mc.office_id LEFT JOIN m_staff ms ON ms.id = ml.loan_officer_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule sched ON sched.loan_id = ml.id AND sched.installment = 1 LEFT JOIN m_loan_disbursement_detail nxt ON nxt.loan_id = ml.id AND nxt.disbursedon_date IS NULL AND nxt.id = ( SELECT n2.id FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail n2 WHERE n2.loan_id = ml.id AND n2.disbursedon_date IS NULL ORDER BY n2.expected_disburse_date, n2.id LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN m_loan_tranche_milestone mile ON mile.loan_id = ml.id AND mile.disbursement_detail_id = nxt.id WHERE lp.allow_multiple_disbursals = 1 AND ml.loan_sub_status_id IN (400, 410, 420, 430, 440, 450) AND (ml.loan_sub_status_id = ${trancheMilestoneStatusId} OR ${trancheMilestoneStatusId} = -1) ORDER BY ml.account_no

column.name: description
column.value: Multi-tranche loan statuses with repayment threshold and survey eligibility. Filter by office, loan officer, product, loan status, and tranche sub-status.

update.column: SELECT ounder.name AS office, ms.display_name AS loanOfficer, mc.display_name AS clientName, ml.account_no AS loanAccount, lp.name AS product, CASE ml.loan_status_id WHEN 100 THEN 'Submitted and pending approval' WHEN 200 THEN 'Approved' WHEN 300 THEN 'Active' WHEN 303 THEN 'Transfer in progress' WHEN 304 THEN 'Transfer on hold' WHEN 400 THEN 'Withdrawn by client' WHEN 500 THEN 'Rejected' WHEN 600 THEN 'Closed' WHEN 601 THEN 'Written off' WHEN 602 THEN 'Rescheduled' WHEN 700 THEN 'Overpaid' ELSE CAST(ml.loan_status_id AS CHAR) END AS loanStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d WHERE d.loan_id = ml.id AND d.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL) AS trancheNumber, CASE ml.loan_sub_status_id WHEN 400 THEN 'Repayment conditions not met' WHEN 410 THEN 'Repayment conditions met' WHEN 420 THEN 'Awaiting survey' WHEN 430 THEN 'Survey successful' WHEN 440 THEN 'Expired' WHEN 450 THEN 'Requires review' ELSE '' END AS trancheStatus, prev.principal AS previousTranchePrincipal, CASE WHEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_as_percentage, ml.previous_tranche_threshold_as_percentage, 1) = 1 THEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum WHEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(ml.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage, lp.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage) END AS requiredPercent, CASE WHEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_as_percentage, ml.previous_tranche_threshold_as_percentage, 1) = 1 THEN ROUND(prev.principal * nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum / 100, 2) WHEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum IS NOT NULL THEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum WHEN COALESCE(ml.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage, lp.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage) IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(prev.principal * COALESCE(ml.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage, lp.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage) / 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS requiredPrincipal, COALESCE(repaid.principal_repaid, 0) AS principalRepaid, CASE WHEN nxt.id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ( CASE WHEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_as_percentage, ml.previous_tranche_threshold_as_percentage, 1) = 1 THEN ROUND(prev.principal * nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum / 100, 2) WHEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum IS NOT NULL THEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum WHEN COALESCE(ml.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage, lp.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage) IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(prev.principal * COALESCE(ml.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage, lp.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage) / 100, 2) ELSE NULL END ) IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(repaid.principal_repaid, 0) >= ( CASE WHEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_as_percentage, ml.previous_tranche_threshold_as_percentage, 1) = 1 THEN ROUND(prev.principal * nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum / 100, 2) WHEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum IS NOT NULL THEN nxt.previous_tranche_repaid_minimum ELSE ROUND(prev.principal * COALESCE(ml.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage, lp.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage) / 100, 2) END ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS thresholdMet, sched.duedate AS eligibilityDeadline, mile.operational_status AS operationalStatus, mile.operational_verified_by_bgs AS operationalVerifiedByBgs, mile.operational_verified_by_investment AS operationalVerifiedByInvestment, mile.additional_funding AS additionalFunding, mile.funding_verified_by_bgs AS fundingVerifiedByBgs, mile.funding_verified_by_investment AS fundingVerifiedByInvestment, mile.conducted_by AS conductedBy, mile.conducted_on AS conductedOn FROM m_loan ml JOIN m_product_loan lp ON lp.id = ml.product_id LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id LEFT JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = mc.office_id JOIN m_office o ON ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') LEFT JOIN m_staff ms ON ms.id = ml.loan_officer_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule sched ON sched.loan_id = ml.id AND sched.installment = COALESCE(ml.grace_on_principal_periods, 0) + 1 LEFT JOIN m_loan_disbursement_detail nxt ON nxt.loan_id = ml.id AND nxt.disbursedon_date IS NULL AND nxt.id = ( SELECT n2.id FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail n2 WHERE n2.loan_id = ml.id AND n2.disbursedon_date IS NULL ORDER BY n2.expected_disburse_date, n2.id LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN m_loan_disbursement_detail prev ON prev.loan_id = ml.id AND prev.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL AND prev.id = ( SELECT p2.id FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail p2 WHERE p2.loan_id = ml.id AND p2.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p2.disbursedon_date DESC, p2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.loan_id, p.id AS previous_id, COALESCE(SUM(t.principal_portion_derived), 0) AS principal_repaid FROM m_loan_transaction t JOIN m_loan_disbursement_detail p ON p.loan_id = t.loan_id AND p.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL WHERE t.transaction_type_enum = 2 AND t.is_reversed = 0 AND t.transaction_date >= p.disbursedon_date AND p.id = ( SELECT p2.id FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail p2 WHERE p2.loan_id = t.loan_id AND p2.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p2.disbursedon_date DESC, p2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY t.loan_id, p.id ) repaid ON repaid.loan_id = ml.id AND repaid.previous_id = prev.id LEFT JOIN m_loan_tranche_milestone mile ON mile.loan_id = ml.id AND mile.disbursement_detail_id = nxt.id WHERE lp.allow_multiple_disbursals = 1 AND (o.id = ${officeId} OR (${officeId} IN (-1, 0) AND o.hierarchy = '${currentUserHierarchy}')) AND (ml.loan_officer_id = ${loanOfficerId} OR ${loanOfficerId} IN (-1, -10, 0)) AND (ml.product_id = ${loanProductId} OR ${loanProductId} IN (-1, 0)) AND (ml.loan_status_id = ${loanStatusId} OR ${loanStatusId} = -1) AND (ml.loan_sub_status_id = ${trancheMilestoneStatusId} OR ${trancheMilestoneStatusId} = -1) ORDER BY ml.account_no
